items.text: Software development builds features and software testing protects quality, and choosing between them depends on whether you enjoy creating or finding problems, with both paths leading to strong careers when you add automation, design and domain depth.
Try a small build and a small test cycle, compare which you enjoy and check notices for both roles in your city.
Ask employers how developers and testers are treated in promotion and project decisions.
